propositions: Closing a bug ticket emits 'Ambiguous prefix' errors for bare 4-hex commit subject fragments and hangs for minutes after the close has durably committed
derive_caused_by performs an unbounded O(commits × tickets) alias scan by re-resolving the bug_id on every commit without memoization or quiet mode
Alias scanning costs ~0.26s per unresolvable 4-hex candidate; with 2137 commits and 620 bare 4-hex subjects, the total latency is ~9 minutes of pure filesystem work
Bare 4-hex and 2-quad hex fragments are being treated as valid ticket reference prefixes in commit-subject candidates but should not collide with alias shapes
Resolution calls in blame.py lack the quiet=True seam already established in close_precheck.py for scanning unqualified candidates
Documentation advertises bare 4-digit short IDs as a supported reference form despite operator decision to deprecate them in favor of 8-digit two-quad, full canonical, alias, and Jira forms
